## Summary

Provide a clear description of the issue.

## Environment

* Platform: (Windows / macOS Intel / Raspberry Pi)
* OS Version:

## Settings

Paste `settings.env` contents **with the password redacted**.

## Expected Behavior

Describe what should happen.

## Actual Behavior

Describe what happened.

## Logs

Paste relevant logs here. See `TROUBLESHOOTING.md` for where each service writes them
(e.g. `C:\ProgramData\music-stack\logs\` on Windows, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\qBittorrent\logs\`).

## Additional Information

Any screenshots or additional context.
